## Additional context

Note that this SDK is intentionally scoped as a low-level protocol layer —
see README "Rozsah první verze": no automatic retry/queue, no cash-register
domain workflow, no PEM/PFX loading in the public API. A request that falls
into one of those categories will likely be declined as out of scope, but
feel free to make the case.
